arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Microsoft's counsel argued that patent law protects against making components in the U.S.
AT&T's counsel argued that Microsoft supplies the precise machine-readable sequence of commands.
Justice Kennedy asked if the disk, not the information, is the component.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of U.S. patent law for digital products. It determines whether companies can avoid liability by sending code abroad. The outcome shapes global software distribution and patent enforcement.
